privacy_meta_description: Braggster keeps your scores on your device. No accounts, no trackers, no data collection.
privacy_intro: Braggster keeps your scores on your phone. There is no server, there are no accounts, and we do not collect your data. Here is what that means in practice.
privacy_collect_p: Nothing. Braggster has no analytics, no advertising, no trackers, and no crash reporting that identifies you. We never see your games, your players, or your scores.
privacy_stored_p: Your games, players, scores and settings are stored only on your device. If you delete the app, that data is gone. If you share a game with another device, it travels straight between the two devices and never passes through us.
privacy_share_p: Nobody. There is nothing to share, because nothing leaves your device.
privacy_website_p: braggster.com is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages. It sets no cookies and runs no analytics. GitHub keeps standard server logs, including your IP address, to serve the page and guard against abuse.
privacy_children_p: Braggster is suitable for all ages. Because we collect nothing, we collect nothing from children either.
privacy_rights_p: Under the GDPR you can access, correct and delete your personal data. We hold none, so there is nothing for us to hand over or erase. Your data stays in your hands, on your device.
privacy_changes_p: If this policy changes, we will update this page and the date above.
